map.📚 深度解析：单株立木材积（二元/形数）计算: 📚 Deep dive: Single Standing Tree Volume (two-entry / form factor) Calculation
map.二元材积 V=a·D^b·H^c（如 0.00005877·D^1.963·H^: Two-entry volume V=a·D^b·H^c (for example 0.00005877·D^1.963·H^0.859); the experimental form factor method gives V=g₁.₃×(H+3)×fε; the mean form factor method gives V=g₁.₃×H×f₁.₃ (g₁.₃=πD²/4/10000). When comparing formulas, take the conservative value.
map.胸径 20 cm、树高 14 m：二元材积=0.00005877×20^1.96: Breast diameter 20 cm, tree height 14 m: two-entry volume = 0.00005877×20^1.963×14^0.859 ≈ 0.2033 m³; the experimental form factor method (f=0.42) gives ≈0.2243 m³. The two are close, with a single-tree output of about 0.20 m³.
map.哪种公式最准？: Which formula is the most accurate?
map.二元材积表（地方）最准，形数法为近似；跨树种、跨地区用通用形数会偏差，重要评估应: The (local) two-entry volume table is the most accurate while the form factor method is an approximation; a universal form factor across species and regions introduces bias, so important assessments should use the local two-entry table.
map.为什么实验形数用 H+3？: Why does the experimental form factor use H+3?
map.形数法将树干延长至梢顶近似（加 3 m 代表梢头），实验形数 fε 已含该修正，: The form factor method approximates the trunk as extended to the top (adding 3 m to represent the top of the bole), and the experimental form factor fε already contains this correction, so a measured bole without the top can still approximate the whole-tree volume.
